annotations.title: Stock Expert AI: ranked stock screen

description:
Return one of Stock Expert AI's ranked lists — the same rows as the site's "Best ... Stocks" pages — for a sector, industry, theme or strategy. Every answer states the exact filter it applied (rankedBy + criteria) and its as-of date.

Cuts (each is a site-wide list; the numeric filter is returned with the rows): best = the scope's list ranked by MoonshotScore · undervalued = P/E ≤ 18, market cap ≥ $1B · dividend = dividend yield 1.5%-12%, market cap ≥ $2B, ranked by yield · high-growth = revenue growth ≥ 15%, market cap ≥ $1B · small-cap = market cap $300M-$2B. Cuts other than "best" are market-wide: a sector or theme scope is not applied to them (scopeApplied=false says so).
Scopes for cut=best: the 11 sectors (technology, healthcare, financial, energy, consumer discretionary, industrial, real estate, utilities, materials, communication, consumer staples), themes (ai, semiconductors, ev, renewable energy, cybersecurity, cloud computing, biotech, cannabis, quantum computing, space, robotics, fintech, metaverse, water) and strategies (dividend, growth, value, penny, blue chip, momentum, defensive, small/mid/large cap, low volatility, undervalued, under 10, under 50).
Covers questions such as "best semiconductor stocks", "undervalued stocks", "top MoonshotScore stocks in healthcare". The rows are a rating order, not picks to buy.
Args: scope (string); cut (enum, default "best"); limit (int 1-20, default 10).
Returns (structuredContent): { scope, cut, rankedBy, criteria, scopeApplied, asOf, rows: [{ rank, ticker, company, moonshotScore, canonicalUrl }], canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }. Rows carry no price, market cap or P/E: full figures on the list page and on each row's stock page.
Errors: "No screen for <scope>" — the scope is not one of the site's lists (the accepted names are listed above).
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.
